name: smwblocks-red-coin
title: Red Coin
description:
A block that acts like a coin, however:
- You get an extra life when you collect 5 of those
- It doesn't turn into a brick when you press a blue P-switch. (The graphics still change, however. You have to change the coin graphics yourself if you want it to look correctly when blue P-switches are used.)

Made for Weegee100's request
